//: Isolated Behat tooling install. Behat 3.x caps symfony/console at ^7, but the root project pins symfony/console ^8 (via xphp-lang/xphp), so Behat cannot live in the root require-dev. Installing it here keeps its symfony 7 dependency tree separate. The files-autoload pulls in the ROOT project's autoloader so the FeatureContext can resolve XPHP\Lsp\* (and phpactor/amp) classes; Behat's own loader is registered first, so its symfony/console 7 wins over the root's 8 (which is never referenced at runtime by the handlers anyway).
